To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Th-GO/PEDOT composite prepared from 40 wt% Th- GO content in reaction medium exhibited the highest specific capacitances of 320 F/g at a current density 1 A/g with excellent cycling stability.
Th-GO could be successfully grafted onto PEDOT chains to form PEDOT/Th-G composites with high degree of conjugation, good thermal stability and porous structure.
Th-GO/PEDOT composites were synthesized via in situ chemical oxidative polymerization and their capacitive performance was investigated.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and characterization of PEDOT/Th-G composite, which can be used as a promising electrode material for supercapacitors.
the preparation of a new composite material with high electrochemical performances for energy storage devices.
the synthesis of PEDOT/Th-GOs composites with different weight percentages of Th-GO, and their application for electrochemical capacitors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the covalent functionalization of graphene oxide with thiophene monomer and the subsequent polymerization with EDOT to form PEDOT/Th-GOs composites are a simple and effective method for the preparation of electrode material with high capacitance.
the Th-GO could be used as a good precursor for the synthesis of PEDOT/Th-G composite materials with improved properties.
the composite of Th-GO and PEDOT could be a promising electrode material for supercapacitor application with good electrochemical performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the covalently linked Th-GO with high doping level of PEDOT could improve the specific capacitance of the composite, and the weight content of Th-GO in the reaction medium could affect the specific capacitance and cycling stability of the composite.
the Th-GO could act as a good template to control the growth of PEDOT, and this composite material would be an excellent candidate for supercapacitor applications.
Th-GO could act as a good candidate as an additive to enhance the performance of PEDOT in supercapacitors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Th-GO can be used as a functionalized GO to prepare composite materials with high performance for electrochemical applications.
the composite of PEDOT and Th-GO with a proper weight percentage of Th- GO could be a promising material for supercapacitors.
the covalently linking Th-GO with polythiophenes can be an efficient approach for the preparation of high-performance PEDOT-based electrode material.
